text: Python CLI implemented as a single file cron_parser.py
Uses only the Python standard library
Parses standard 5-field cron expressions (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week); rejects other field counts
Validates field ranges and rejects out-of-range / malformed values
validate <expr> subcommand explains each field for valid expressions
validate <expr> reports the error for invalid expressions (non-zero exit, message)
next <expr> prints the next run times from now (default count)
next <expr> -n N prints exactly N run times, computed correctly
Handles invalid dates such as February 30 (never produced; impossible schedules reported, not hang)
Standard cron day-of-month/day-of-week OR semantics when both restricted
